title: Fronius Solar Web Weekly Energy Today Trend
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fronius:solar energy_today_kwh=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(energy_today_kwh) as avg_duration, max(energy_today_kwh) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst energy today for Fronius inverter reading events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture energy_today_kwh on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average energy today with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It scans whether Fronius inverter reading tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
